title: {{name}} and the Little Bird
text:
{{name}} loved animals very much.
One sunny day, {{name}} went to the park.
There was a little bird on the cold ground.
The bird could not fly back to its nest.
"Oh no! I must help you," said {{name}}.
The nest was high up in a big tree.
"I am going to climb up," said {{name}}.
The tree was very tall and old.
{{name}} felt a little bit scared.
"I should be brave," {{name}} said softly.
When {{name}} looked up, the nest looked far away.
But {{name}} did not want to stop.
Step by step, {{name}} climbed up the tree.
The little bird made a soft, happy sound.
"You are so kind," it seemed to say.
At last, {{name}} reached the top branch.
The baby bird was safe back in its nest.
Soon the mother bird flew home to the tree.
She sang a sweet song for {{name}}.
{{name}} climbed down with a very big smile.
"We must always help our animal friends," said {{name}}.
From that day on, the birds knew {{name}}.
Every morning, they sang by the window.
When {{name}} woke up, the birds were always there.
They were going to be friends for a long time.

questions.prompt: Why could the little bird not go back to its nest?
options: It was too tired to sing
It could not fly up to the nest
It did not like its mother

questions.prompt: How did {{name}} feel before climbing the tall tree?
options: A little scared, but then brave
Happy and not scared at all

questions.prompt: What did the birds do every morning after that day?
options: They hid inside the big tree
